# External editor

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Built-in tools and hand-off · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

src/desktop/editors.ts (detection of five editors by known place and PATH), src/desktop/main.ts `open-in-editor` (world folders only, no shell text from the page), main.ts `openOutside` (map right-click and palette, remembered choice, no-editor message), tests/editors.test.ts

## What is missing

opening a single file or an export in the editor; run in the real desktop app on Linux with a stand-in editor on PATH, not on a Windows PC
